Thanks for filing this. This is an automatic acknowledgement, posted by a bot, so you know your report arrived.

{{#away}}The maintainer is away until {{date}}, so a personal reply may take longer than usual. Security reports always have a separate private channel (see SECURITY.md) and are handled first.

{{/away}}What happens next: the maintainer aims to reply {{target}}, saying whether the report is confirmed, needs more information, or is a question the documentation already answers. A reply is not a promise of a fix date. Fixes are announced on this issue once they are available in main.

While you wait: Settings, System Health (status.php in your install) lists many common causes, and docs/SUPPORT-PATTERNS.md covers the usual shapes of report. For general questions, the Google Group (open-source-cad) is also a good place to ask: https://groups.google.com/g/open-source-cad
